product.name: CT Scan
product.description: A diagnostic imaging procedure using X-rays to create detailed cross-sectional images of the body for medical evaluation.

product.name: Interventional Procedures
product.description: Minimally invasive, image-guided medical procedures performed by radiologists to diagnose or treat conditions.

product.name: Nuclear Medicine
product.description: Diagnostic imaging using radioactive tracers to assess organ and tissue function.

product.name: PET/CT
product.description: A combined imaging technique using positron-emitting tracers and CT to visualize metabolic activity and anatomy.

product.name: MRI
product.description: Magnetic Resonance Imaging uses magnetic fields and radio waves to produce detailed images of internal body structures.

product.name: Ultrasound
product.description: Imaging technique using high-frequency sound waves to visualize internal organs and tissues in real-time.
